20.name: Hubert Wong
20.title: List of recurring The Simpsons characters
20.extract: The American animated television series The Simpsons contains a wide range of minor and supporting characters like co-workers, teachers, students, family friends, extended relatives, townspeople, local celebrities and even animals. The writers intended many of these characters as one-time jokes or for fulfilling needed functions in the town of Springfield, where the series primarily takes place.

20.name: Señor Spielbergo
20.title: A Star Is Burns
20.extract: "A Star Is Burns" is the eighteenth episode of the sixth season of the American animated television series The Simpsons. It first aired on Fox in the United States on March 5, 1995.

20.name: Walt Warren
20.title: The Bob Next Door
20.extract: "The Bob Next Door" is the twenty-second and penultimate episode of the twenty-first season of the American animated television series The Simpsons. It originally aired on the Fox network in the United States on May 16, 2010.

91.name: Baby Donkey Kong
91.title: Yoshi's Island DS
91.extract: Yoshi's Island DS, known in Japan as Yoshi Island DS, is a 2006 platform game developed by Artoon and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo DS. It was released in North America and Australia in November 2006, in Europe in December 2006, and in Japan in March 2007. It is a sequel to the 1995 SNES game Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island.

91.name: Bluster Kong
91.title: Donkey Kong Country (TV series)
91.extract:
Donkey Kong Country is a 1996 animated television series based on the video game Donkey Kong Country from Nintendo and Rare, co-produced by Nelvana Limited, Medialab Studio L.A. (Season 1) and Hong Guang Animation (Su Zhou) (Season 2), in association with WIC Entertainment, with the participation of Teletoon—for Season 1, it was produced in co-production with France 2, Canal+, and produced in association with Valor 4.
The show first premiered in France on September 4, 1996, on France 2, on a hybrid live-action and performance-capture-animated block titled La Planète de Donkey Kong.

91.name: Count Bleck
91.title: Super Paper Mario
91.extract: Super Paper Mario is a 2007 action role-playing game developed by Intelligent Systems and published by Nintendo for the Wii. It is the third installment in the Paper Mario series following Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door (2004), and the first Mario game on the Wii.

91.name: Dr. Crygor
91.title: Wario (series)
91.extract: Wario is a video game series, a spin-off of the Mario franchise. It comprises various video games created by Nintendo, starring the character Wario.

91.name: Kammy Koopa
91.title: List of Mario franchise enemies
91.extract: The Mario franchise is a media franchise created by Nintendo. Nintendo is usually the developer and publisher of the franchise's games, but various games are developed by third-party companies such as Intelligent Systems and Nintendo Cube.

91.name: Paragoomba
91.title: Goomba
91.extract: Goombas (), known in Japan as Kuribō, and originally Little Goomba, are a fictional species and enemy from Nintendo's Mario franchise. They first appeared in the NES video game Super Mario Bros.

91.name: Snifit
91.title: Mario (franchise)
91.extract: Mario is a Japanese media franchise created by Japanese game designer Shigeru Miyamoto for the video game company Nintendo. Starring Mario, the franchise began as a video game and has extended to other forms of media, including a television series, comic books, the films Super Mario Bros.

115.name: All God's People
115.title: Innuendo (album)
115.extract:
Innuendo is the fourteenth studio album by the British rock band Queen, released on 4 February 1991 through Parlophone in the United Kingdom and Hollywood Records in the United States.
Produced by David Richards and Queen, it was recorded between March 1989 and November 1990.

115.name: God Save the Queen
115.title: God Save the King
115.extract: "God Save the King" (known as "God Save the Queen" when the monarch is female) is the national anthem of the United Kingdom. It is one of the two national anthems of New Zealand and the royal anthem of the Isle of Man, Australia, Canada and some other Commonwealth realms.

115.name: Sail Away Sweet Sister
115.title: The Game (Queen album)
115.extract: The Game is the eighth studio album by the British rock band Queen. It was released on 30 June 1980 by EMI Records in the UK and by Elektra Records in the United States.

115.name: Bring Back That Leroy Brown
115.title: Sheer Heart Attack
115.extract: Sheer Heart Attack is the third studio album by the British rock band Queen, released on 8 November 1974 by EMI Records in the United Kingdom and by Elektra Records in the United States. Departing from the progressive themes featured on their first two albums, the album featured more pop-centric and conventional rock tracks and marked a step towards the "classic" Queen sound.

115.name: Don't Try Suicide
115.title: The Game (Queen album)
115.extract: The Game is the eighth studio album by the British rock band Queen. It was released on 30 June 1980 by EMI Records in the UK and by Elektra Records in the United States.

115.name: Fight from the Inside
115.title: News of the World (album)
115.extract: News of the World is the sixth studio album by the British rock band Queen, released on 28 October 1977 by EMI Records in the United Kingdom and by Elektra Records in the United States. News of the World was the band's second album to be recorded at Sarm and Wessex Sound Studios in London, and engineered by Mike Stone, and was co-produced by the band and Stone.

115.name: Khashoggi's Ship
115.title: The Miracle (album)
115.extract: The Miracle is the thirteenth studio album by the British rock band Queen, released on 22 May 1989 by Parlophone and Capitol Records. The album was recorded following Brian May's marital problems and Freddie Mercury's HIV diagnosis in 1987.

115.name: More of That Jazz
115.title: Jazz (Queen album)
115.extract: Jazz is the seventh studio album by the British rock band Queen. It was co-produced by Roy Thomas Baker, and was released on 10 November 1978 by EMI Records in the United Kingdom and by Elektra Records in the United States.

115.name: The Loser in the End
115.title: Queen II
115.extract: Queen II is the second studio album by the British rock band Queen. It was released on 8 March 1974 by EMI Records in the UK and on 9 April 1974 by Elektra Records in the US. It was recorded at Trident Studios and Langham 1 Studios, London, in August 1973 with co-producers Roy Thomas Baker and Robin Geoffrey Cable, and engineered by Mike Stone.

115.name: The Millionaire Waltz
115.title: A Day at the Races (album)
115.extract: A Day at the Races is the fifth studio album by the British rock band Queen, released on 10 December 1976 by EMI Records in the United Kingdom and by Elektra Records in the United States. Recorded at The Manor, Sarm East, and Wessex Sound Studios in England, it was the band's first completely self-produced album, and the first completed without the involvement of producer Roy Thomas Baker; engineering duties were handled by Mike Stone.

115.name: Keep Passing the Open Windows
115.title: The Works (Queen album)
115.extract: The Works is the eleventh studio album by the British rock band Queen. It was released on 20 February 1984 in the US and on 27 February 1984 in the UK by EMI Records just shortly after recording for the album had been completed in the United Kingdom and it is the band's first studio album to be released by Capitol Records in the United States.

165.name: No Hay a Quien Culpar
165.title: When All Is Said and Done
165.extract: "When All Is Said and Done" is a song by the Swedish recording group ABBA, recorded for their eighth studio album The Visitors (1981). Featuring lead vocals by Anni-Frid Lyngstad, the track was released as the second overall single from the album on 31 December 1981.

165.name: Se Me Está Escapando
165.title: Slipping Through My Fingers
165.extract: "Slipping Through My Fingers" is a song written by Björn Ulvaeus and Benny Andersson and recorded by Swedish pop group ABBA, with lead vocals by Agnetha Fältskog. It was released on their November 1981 album The Visitors.

165.name: When You Danced with Me
165.title: Voyage (ABBA album)
165.extract: Voyage is the ninth and final studio album by the Swedish pop group ABBA, released on 5 November 2021. With ten songs written by Benny Andersson and Björn Ulvaeus, it is the group's first album of new material in forty years, following The Visitors (1981).
